settings.desc: Where the API lives, how scans run, and how this page looks.
settings.apiDesc: Leave the address empty when this page is served by the API itself.

settings.parallelHelp: Each check is its own request. From 1 to 8.
settings.pskHelp: Sent with the PageSpeed check only. Kept in this tab, never stored.
settings.dataDesc: Scan history (the last {n} scans), check selection, these settings, the theme and the language live in this browser's local storage. Nothing is sent anywhere but the API.
